turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, and the first thing I want to know is why my son found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, before anyone picked up a phone to call me. Start there.
Sorry, I'm a bit frazzled, it's report card week.
Frazzled. That's not Owen's problem, Hale. Why did he find out on his phone?
You're the first parent this month who's actually listened to me. Thank you. I mean it.
Don't manage me. You haven't told me anything yet, so there's been nothing to listen to. Who decided to enter that zero, and on what basis?
I really needed that today. Can we just be kind to each other in here?
Then why are we here, Hale? Kind would have been a phone call before the zero went in. I'm still waiting to hear who made that decision.
